college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: The Department of English and Department of Theatre offer an interdisciplinary combined major that integrates performance, design, production, and dramatic literature with literary studies, digital humanities, and creative writing. This combined major offers both classroom and experiential learning in making theatre, playwriting, and dramaturgy with the study of the diverse historical, cultural, and aesthetic contexts of literature. Students develop the capacity for interpreting a variety of texts through performance and writing to engage audiences.
